"It's getting worse, not better. If it festers I'm no good to anyone — can't haul, can't hunt, can't watch. Just clean it out and wrap it tight."
Move next to them, on the same side of the Haven door, to help.
"Sorry — I shouldn't load that on you. What's up?"
"The whole fire was arguing about Hummice last night — what to even CALL it. 'The Ugly Beast' got shouted down. What's your vote?"
"Take your time."
"Not right now. I've got my own things to handle."
You show them Wild Black Cherry — where it grows, how to tell it apart. A short laugh. "And I've been walking past it for weeks."
"...I need to go be quiet for a while."
A comfortable quiet settles. They smile a little, and let it be.
"...Think about it? I'll be around."
"This was good." They mean it.
"Hah. Have you ever hurt someone? Since all this started."
They nod, slow. "Okay. Thank you for telling me. That couldn't have been easy to say."
"Sure — Still on whether you've hurt someone."
"Alright. But I'm not carrying your stuff."
"Help me haul something back? Too much for one."
You walk to the cache spot with Somchai. Nothing much there — but they talk the whole way, and you learn the shape of them a little better.
"Forget I said anything. What did you want?"
"Huh. Let me think about that." "Have you heard what they're calling Hummice? Ruth is pushing 'The Loud Beast'. Everyone's got a name for it and nobody agrees."
"I see." They take a moment to think about your answer.
"Gotta run. Literally. Bye!"
You say nothing. Neither do they, for a while — and it's fine.
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
"What's the most useful thing you've learned since we got here?"
"Okay." Something shutters, just slightly.
"Still on the most useful thing you've learned. Just thinking out loud."
"Someone should watch your back. Might as well be me."
"Sorry — I shouldn't load that on you. What's up?"
"A name. Okay." You say it out loud, trying the shape of it:
They go very still. Not relaxed-still. Held-still.
"Ha. Funny." The laugh is dry. "Is this what we're doing now? Interrogations?"
You don't answer. The quiet turns pointed.
"I should get back to it."
"Right. Well." That's the whole goodbye.
"About this wound — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you?"
"...Sorry, lost my train of thought."
"Forget I said anything. What did you want?"
"Last time things were different. They always are." "Arlo owed me a favor. I keep thinking about collecting. Stupid."

"The fire feels smaller without Arlo. The rest of us will have to be bigger."
"I oil boots on rest days for Arlo, now. Feels right. Feels like the least I can do."
"Still on what's been happening."
You show them American Persimmon — where it grows, how to tell it apart. They nod slowly, committing it to memory. "Good to know. Really good to know."
"I should go. You know where to find me."

"Sleep's gone strange. I check the treeline every hour at odd hours now. Whatever gets me to morning."
"Roles. Not ranks — promises."
"Nobody says Arlo's name right yet. We will. Give it a few days."
"Still on what's been happening."

"Still on what was on their mind."
"Anyway — I should get going."

"Good — the most useful thing you've learned, settled. Feels better said out loud."
"Can I tell you something? I stole medicine from the stash once and never confessed."
"Walk my trap line with me? Extra hands, extra eyes."

deathBeat: d17: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Arlo Wan is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d17: 🕯️ Arlo Wan is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
recoverHome: d18: That night, they bring Arlo home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.
systemVoice: d17: SYSTEM: "Perimeter violated! This is unprecedented! ...Is this unprecedented? Checking. Yes. Unprecedented."

d17: ◈ ARC III — ENGINES. SYSTEM: "VIEWERSHIP MILESTONE. Organic unit demonstrates compounding capability. Resonance protocols unlocked." — Your gifts deepen. Used in sequence, they resonate. The village is no longer just surviving. It is becoming something.
d17: ⬢ SYSTEM: "Neural depth 65. I can hold more of you now — ability slots: 5."
d17: SYSTEM: Naming things. Very human. The audience approves.
d17: SYSTEM: Oh! It has a NAME. You all love names.
d18: 📺 SYSTEM: "We have already cleared your morning. You are welcome. We require 300 kcal of tubers and your full attention. The fans love a cooking segment."
d18: 📺 SYSTEM: "We will keep practicing on our own." You decide, firmly, not to ask what that means.
